description: This file defines the interface for the TextToSpeech (TTS) Manager, including configuration structures, callback classes, and the main TTSManager class with methods for controlling TTS functionalities such as speaking, pausing, resuming, and event handling.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Holds TTS configuration parameters such as endpoint URLs, language, voice, volume, and rate.

classes.name: TTSEventCallback
classes.description: Interface for TTS event callbacks, including state changes, speech events, errors, and completion.

classes.name: TTSManager
classes.description: Main class managing TTS operations, including speech control, configuration, and event handling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a TTSManager instance with a specified event callback.

methods.name: TTSManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing TTSManager with an event callback.

methods.name: ~TTSManager
methods.description: Destructor for TTSManager.

methods.name: enableTTS
methods.description: Enables or disables TTS functionality.

methods.name: isTTSEnabled
methods.description: Checks if TTS is currently enabled.

methods.name: listVoices
methods.description: Lists available voices for a specified language.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the TTS configuration parameters.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the current TTS configuration.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Initiates speech synthesis for given text with a specific speech ID.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses ongoing speech with the specified ID.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes paused speech with the specified ID.

methods.name: shut
methods.description: Stops speech with the specified ID.

methods.name: isSpeaking
methods.description: Checks if speech with the given ID is currently in progress.

methods.name: getSpeechState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of speech with the given ID.

methods.name: clearAudioPipeline
methods.description: Clears the audio pipeline.

methods.name: willSpeak
methods.description: Event triggered before speech starts.

methods.name: started
methods.description: Event triggered when speech starts.

methods.name: spoke
methods.description: Event triggered when speech completes.

methods.name: paused
methods.description: Event triggered when speech is paused.

methods.name: resumed
methods.description: Event triggered when speech is resumed.

methods.name: cancelled
methods.description: Event triggered when speech is cancelled.

methods.name: interrupted
methods.description: Event triggered when speech is interrupted.

methods.name: networkerror
methods.description: Event triggered on network error during speech.

methods.name: playbackerror
methods.description: Event triggered on playback error during speech.
